decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution builds directly on the firm's core aviation security and border data knowledge, and its proven government use (UK e-Borders, over 30 APIS schemes) shows strong commercial application.
The travel health requirements API draws on related travel document and data knowledge, but post-pandemic demand is fading, so its value is uncertain even though it currently keeps a dedicated page.

Cyber awareness training sits furthest from the firm's physical and aviation security knowledge base, gets only a mention on the website, and faces crowded competition, so the firm can absorb little that would improve it.
Behaviour analysis complements the firm's screening and profiling expertise, letting it interpret results and refine the system despite its low web visibility.
Passenger security profiling is a core competence closely tied to the firm's aviation security operations, so it fits existing knowledge well.
The document verification web platform extends the firm's established document-checking know-how and has a page of its own, supporting continued development.
